trello.name: Fix Android Photo Upload Crash
trello.desc: Marcus to investigate and fix the NullPointerException issue in the media picker callback when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload on Android 14. Ensure the fix is verified by QA by Wednesday.

trello.name: Confirm Android Crash Fix
trello.desc: Sam to confirm the fix for the Android photo upload crash on Android 14 test devices once Marcus lands it. Include the fix in the regression run.

trello.name: Implement Offline Mode for Notes List
trello.desc: Elena to build the backend sync API that sends a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes based on the last-synced timestamp. Marcus to develop the client-side functionality with a local cache in Room, queue offline writes, and replay them once online. Ensure it supports viewing and editing notes offline, with reconciliation upon reconnecting.

trello.name: Migrate CI to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam to complete the migration of build, test, and release pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Run both systems in parallel for a week and maintain the nightly build schedule. Keep Jenkins operational until the parallel run is clean.

trello.name: Implement Per-User Rate Limiting on Search Endpoint
trello.desc: Elena to add per-user rate limiting of 100 requests per minute on the search endpoint. Return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header if the limit is exceeded. Include a metrics counter to track usage.

trello.name: Update GDPR Compliance on Consent Screen
trello.desc: Marcus to update the privacy policy consent screen to meet GDPR requirements. Implement opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, ensuring nothing is pre-checked. This update is a blocker for the August 20 release.

trello.name: Create Automated Tests for Payments Flow
trello.desc: Sam to develop regression tests covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation paths for the payments flow. These tests should be integrated into the CI pipeline using GitHub Actions.
